# EzAI API

> > EzAI API provides unified access to Claude, GPT, and Gemini models with simplified authentication, one-command setup for Claude Code and Cursor, and production-ready error handling.

EzAI API is a developer platform that streamlines AI integration by offering a single API for multiple AI providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, xAI Grok). The platform specializes in Python-based tutorials, production error handling, and seamless integration with popular AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Cline.

## Key Topics

- Claude API integration
- Python AI development
- Multi-model API access
- Claude Code setup
- Cursor integration
- Rate limiting and exponential backoff
- Production error handling
- API authentication
- FastAPI tutorials
- Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5
- OpenAI GPT migration
- AI embeddings and semantic search
- RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
- AI API pricing comparison
- Extended thinking mode
